How to play

Move, jump, ask Pack for help

Keyboard

  • ADMove
  • SPACEJump and climb
  • SDrop from a ledge
  • EInteract, or send Pack
  • RRestart from checkpoint

Touch

  • Joystick to move and drop
  • ↑Jump and climb
  • ACTInteract, or send Pack

Signing in is optional. It saves your best times and cogs so they follow you between devices. Sign-in is handled by Google Firebase, which keeps the name and email your Google account shares. The game itself stores only your progress.
